name: libkdcraw
description: Libkdcraw is a KDE wrapper around the libraw-0.22.0 library for manipulating image metadata.

user:
cmake -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$KF6_PREFIX \
      -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release         \
      -D BUILD_TESTING=OFF                \
      -D QT_MAJOR_VERSION=6               \
      -W no-dev ..
